title: inula verbascifolia subsp. aschersoniana
intro: Inula verbascifolia subsp. aschersoniana, commonly known as Ascheners Golden Inula, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, providing relief from digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory disorders. The bioactive constituents of Inula verbascifolia subsp. aschersoniana include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
